config.objective: class-balanced logistic + L2 on frozen96d latent
config.selection: fixed final step; no CV or checkpoint search
config.guard: one owned NumPy worker for both arms; parent-enforced 60s campaign and 2048MiB sampled process-tree threshold
config.validation_diagnostics: baseline and final only per arm; four total, never selection

limitations: Classifier of authored versus constructed declarations, not deck quality, legality, win probability, or playing strength.
Frozen baseline plus original engineering initialization; independent of auxiliary declaration fits.
No dynamic remaining-deck ledger, transition/effect objective, world-model fit, game, or opponent execution.
One seed, small inherited family holdout, and shared card identities limit generalization claims.
Incomplete-original-size curves are out-of-distribution diagnostics, never remaining-pile bad labels.
An IR trait-target relation grounds a package fixture, not strategic gain; the frozen encoder consumes printed traits, not program semantics.

factor_identity_overlap.note: Factor-bin overlap has hash collisions; exact card overlap must be reported from dataset lineage.

curves.calibration: Balanced authored-vs-constructed training prior; not a calibrated quality/win probability.

metadata.control_path: fixed admitted matched-alternative anchor at every nominal restoration step; actual original copies restored always zero

source_admission.scope: new declared Premier main plus explicitly empty sideboard; no playability or strategy certification

rule_witness.mechanism: other friendly unit sharing a source trait can enable contingent damage prevention

effect_node.title: Defeat a friendly unit that shares a trait with Queen Amidala to prevent all damage to her

rule_witness.claim_scope: explicit source trait-dependent interaction, not demonstrated beneficial synergy or gameplay value
